Ex-Rwandan Official Faces Genocide Charges in UK Court

A former Rwandan official has appeared in a UK court facing charges related to the 1994 genocide. He is the first person to be charged in the UK for offenses connected to the genocide. The man, identified as a doctor in one report, appeared in court in the UK. The specific charges relate to genocide offenses.
